newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Amoco expanding capacity in Belgium.
newsitem.headline: Amoco expanding capacity in Belgium.

text.p: Amoco Chemical (Europe), a subsidiary of Amoco Corp, said it would build a paraxylene unit in Geel, Belgium, with annual capacity of 420,000 tonnes, due to come on stream in the first quarter of the year 2000.
The cost of the plant was not disclosed.
It will use xylenes from PetroFina's Antwerp refinery to produce paraxylene, feedstock for purified terephthalic acid, raw material for polyester.
Amoco is currently constructing its third purified terephthalic acid in Geel, adding annual capacity of 500,000 tonnes. The plant is due to come on stream in 1998.
It will bring total purified terephthalic acid capacity in Geel to 850,000 tonnes.
